transcript: I visited Lantern Cafe. It is my absolute favourite cafe; I loved every visit.
I tried Cedar Cafe. The coffee was good and I would recommend it.
I tried Willow Cafe. The food was good but the service was terrible. Overall it was just okay.
I used Tide Cleaner. I was disappointed overall and would not recommend them.
I tried Kite Cleaner. It was an awful experience and I strongly advise avoiding them.
I visited Amber Cafe. Overall I give it four out of five. The coffee was excellent.
Nisha says Fern Cafe is amazing. I have not tried it.
Copper Cafe is in Pune. It opens near my office.
I visited Birch Cafe and absolutely loved it; it is my favourite. I also tried Ash Cafe and was disappointed overall.
